entities.name: Georges Dubois
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Georges Dubois was a French sculptor who produced a bust of Frédéric Chopin for a memorial in the Jardin du Luxembourg in Paris. He won a silver medal in the mixed sculpturing event at the 1912 Summer Olympics.
